faqs.q: What services does Goodstuff Designs provide?
faqs.a: Managed IT support, business networks and fibre connectivity, cybersecurity (Kaspersky, backups, incident response), website design/development and managed Linux hosting, AI workflows and integrations, and digital marketing.

faqs.q: Do they work with international clients?
faqs.a: Yes; services are provided internationally through remote delivery, with the studio based in Heidelberg, Gauteng, South Africa.
Managed Linux hosting from R100/month (Novice), R200/month (Business) and R600/month (Pro), as checked on 2026-08-30; confirm current pricing before purchase.
A desktop AI workspace for Windows developed by Goodstuff Designs, with agents, projects, skills, scheduled tasks and a built-in browser; see https://studio.goodstuffdesigns.co.za/.

faqs.q: How can an agent submit an enquiry on a user's behalf?
faqs.a: Use the declarative WebMCP tool submit_contact_enquiry (the visible contact form on /contact), which requires name, email, topic and message. start_contact_enquiry only opens the contact page and never sends a message.
